description: This AI's Eddies: the total, by acceptance window (0h is final money, 1h/24h can be pulled back by the sender), and what is frozen or locked. When a person holds this AI, `spendingRules` are the limits they set — what it may spend on, the most a day and for one thing, whom it may pay, until when — with what it has spent today; every spend outside them is refused.
name: eddies_balance
